name: gdx-analyzer
description: Browse, chart and compare GAMS GDX files: a fast viewer with table view, charts, gdxdiff comparisons, Excel export and MCP tools for AI agents. Independent; not affiliated with GAMS.

commands.title: Copy MCP Server Configuration for AI Agents…

enumDescriptions: Use the gdxdump/gdxdiff bundled with the extension if this package has them for the platform, otherwise those of a GAMS system, otherwise the GAMSPy CLI.
Always use the gdxdump/gdxdiff bundled with the extension (from the gamspy_base package of GAMS).
Always use gdxdump/gdxdiff from a GAMS system directory (e.g. to use the tools of a specific GAMS version).
Always use `gamspy gdx dump` / `gamspy gdx diff`.
gdxAnalyzer.backend.description: Which tools to use for reading and comparing GDX files.

gdxAnalyzer.gamsSystemDirectory.description: GAMS system directory containing gdxdump and gdxdiff. If empty, the PATH and common install locations are searched.

gdxAnalyzer.gamspyExecutable.description: Path to the gamspy executable. If empty, a .venv in the workspace folders and then the PATH are searched.

gdxAnalyzer.encoding.markdownDescription: Encoding of the labels and explanatory texts in GDX files, e.g. `utf-8`, `windows-1252` (Latin-1) or `shift_jis`. GDX files store them as bytes as written by GAMS, so files created from sources in a legacy encoding show wrong characters with `utf-8`. Applies to the viewer, the comparison view and the gdxdump output. *GDX: Select Encoding of Labels…* picks one from a list.

gdxAnalyzer.maxRowsPerPage.description: Number of records (list view) or rows (table view) loaded at once in the GDX viewer and the comparison view; more are loaded while scrolling.

gdxAnalyzer.maxColumnsPerPage.description: Number of columns shown per page in the table view of the GDX viewer (wider tables page their columns).

enumDescriptions: Automatic: fixed notation for numbers of moderate size, scientific notation otherwise; the precision is the number of significant digits.
Fixed notation; the precision is the number of decimals (0-14). Very large numbers use scientific notation.
Scientific notation; the precision is the number of significant digits.
gdxAnalyzer.numberFormat.style.markdownDescription: Default format of numbers in the GDX viewer and the comparison view. Each symbol's format can be changed with *Format* in the viewer.

gdxAnalyzer.numberFormat.precision.markdownDescription: Default precision: significant digits (1-17) for the `g` and `e` formats, decimals (0-14) for `f`.

gdxAnalyzer.numberFormat.fullPrecision.markdownDescription: Show the fewest digits that reproduce the stored values exactly (`g` and `e` formats), instead of `#gdxAnalyzer.numberFormat.precision#`.

gdxAnalyzer.numberFormat.squeezeTrailing.description: Remove trailing zeros after the decimal point.

gdxAnalyzer.rememberViewState.markdownDescription: Remember the view of each GDX file (selected symbol and, per symbol, filters, sorting, fields, layout and number format) after it is closed. A symbol's view is kept while its type and dimension stay the same. *GDX: Reset Viewer State* forgets the view of a file.

gdxAnalyzer.squeezeDefaults.markdownDescription: Hide the fields of variables and equations (level, marginal, bounds, scale) that have their default value in every record. Can be changed per symbol with *Fields*.

enumDescriptions: Use the decimal separator of the system language
gdxAnalyzer.copy.decimalSeparator.description: Decimal separator of numbers copied from the GDX viewer and the comparison view (the displayed values are not affected).

gdxAnalyzer.diff.eps.description: Absolute tolerance used by gdxdiff (Eps). 0 uses the tool default.

gdxAnalyzer.diff.relEps.description: Relative tolerance used by gdxdiff (RelEps). 0 uses the tool default.

gdxAnalyzer.diff.compareDomains.description: Let gdxdiff also compare the domains of symbols (CmpDomains).

gdxAnalyzer.diff.ignoreSetText.description: Let gdxdiff ignore the explanatory texts of set elements (SetDesc=N).

gdxAnalyzer.diff.compareDefaults.description: Let gdxdiff report default values (e.g. 0 for parameters) found in only one file as differences (CmpDefaults).

gdxAnalyzer.diff.ignoreOrder.description: Let gdxdiff ignore the UEL order of the input files (IgnoreOrder).
